summary: Backend-only regression testing of the JSONB double-encoding fix and the 'caseload' language ban. Built a new 20-test pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_jsonb_fix_iter74.py) covering every write path the developer touched (review.py: PUT actions / learning_needs / evidence, PATCH risks, PATCH action toggle, POST risk-suggestions, PATCH speaker-text, POST mark-reviewed, POST signoff, POST share; admin.py: PATCH team-insights actions/learning_needs/achievements registers) plus a data-integrity sweep asserting jsonb_typeof != 'string'. Every write is verified by a fresh GET (refresh simulation) AND a direct jsonb_typeof DB assertion, then state is restored. ALL fixed paths pass (18/23 tests green). The reported 'Failed to Save' Learning Need bug is fixed and persists as a proper jsonb array. HOWEVER, the root cause is NOT fully fixed: ~12 other call sites still call json.dumps() before a $N::jsonb bind, and I proved live via the API that they still write double-encoded jsonb (5 intentionally-failing tests in /app/backend/tests/test_remaining_jsonb_iter74.py). Frontend UI automation was skipped per request.

critical.endpoint: PUT /api/org/branding (routers/org.py:426, and logo upload at org.py:464)
critical.issue: PROVEN LIVE: after a successful PUT, organisations.branding has jsonb_typeof='string' (double-encoded). json.dumps() is still applied before the ::jsonb bind. Not covered by the init_db startup repair migration, so it stays corrupted forever. Test: test_remaining_jsonb_iter74.py::test_put_branding_double_encodes_jsonb

PROVEN LIVE: standards_entries.keywords stored with jsonb_typeof='string'. 109 of 239 existing rows are already double-encoded. Keyword matching / evidence rescan that iterates keywords will see a string, not a list. Test: test_create_standard_double_encodes_keywords

PROVEN via DB: `recording_events = recording_events || $1::jsonb` with json.dumps([event]) appends STRING elements. Real rows now contain ["[{\"type\": \"started\"...}]", "[{\"type\": \"stopped\"...}]"] — nested stringified arrays instead of event objects. Same bug for paused_periods (line 164). jsonb_typeof of the column is still 'array' so the startup repair migration silently misses it. Test: test_recording_events_elements_are_objects

The MAIN AI analysis INSERT still json.dumps() actions/risks/cqc_mappings/care_cert_mappings/custom_mappings/achievements/learning_needs before ::jsonb, plus transcripts.safety_warnings (line 169) and meeting_prep.coverage_results (line 380). Confirmed empirically that with_admin() connections double-encode identically to with_org(). Evidence of live corruption: transcripts.safety_warnings currently has 3 rows with jsonb_typeof='string' (that column is NOT in the startup repair list). Every newly analysed meeting therefore writes double-encoded analysis JSONB until the next backend restart runs the repair migration.

minor.issue: Same json.dumps()-before-::jsonb pattern (meetings.attendees, settings.data, standards_documents.extracted_criteria). meetings.attendees is repaired at startup, the other two are not.

'caseload' safety net gap: its system prompt contains NO language rule and the returned mappings are NOT passed through _sanitise_analysis/_apply_uk_language, so custom-document evidence mappings can still contain 'caseload'.
Returns result without _sanitise_analysis(); relies on the prompt only, no regex safety net (unlike analyze_meeting which does sanitise).
Login latency 3-11s and one request exceeded 60s → ingress returned 502. OTP email send appears to be on the request path; move it to a background task.

/app/backend/tests/test_team_insights_registers.py and test_report_lock.py are stale: they read BASE_URL from process env only and use Bearer tokens from the login response (pre-cookie/MFA auth) → all auth'd tests now fail with 401 'Invalid token'. Not a product bug, but these suites give false negatives.

action_items: Remove the remaining json.dumps() calls before ::jsonb binds: routers/processing.py:169,326,327,328,329,336,343,350,380; routers/recording.py:90,127,164,169,203; routers/org.py:426,464; routers/admin.py:295,392,505,2254; utils/seed.py:176.

For recording.py the concat form must pass a raw list: `recording_events || $1::jsonb` with [event] (not json.dumps([event])) — and add a repair migration that un-nests existing stringified ELEMENTS (jsonb_typeof of the column is 'array', so the current migration misses it).

Extend the init_db startup repair to transcripts.safety_warnings, meeting_prep.coverage_results, organisations.branding, standards_entries.keywords, settings.data, standards_documents.extracted_criteria — all currently or potentially double-encoded and unrepaired (109 standards_entries.keywords rows + 3 transcripts.safety_warnings rows + 1 organisations.branding row are corrupt right now).
Add a lint/CI guard (grep for `json.dumps` on the same line/args as `::jsonb`) so this class of bug cannot reappear — the codec in database._init_connection always double-encodes.
Apply _sanitise_analysis()/_apply_uk_language() to analyze_custom_only() and analyze_doc_for_evidence() outputs and add the caseload language rule to analyze_custom_only's system prompt.
Move MFA OTP email sending off the login request path (login took up to 60s → 502).
critical_code_review_comments: database._init_connection registers a jsonb encoder=json.dumps on EVERY pooled connection (both with_org and with_admin) — verified empirically: `SELECT jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb)` returns 'string' for json.dumps(x) and 'array' for a raw list on both context managers. So the rule is absolute: never json.dumps() a jsonb bind parameter anywhere in this codebase.

Relying on a startup repair migration to clean corrupted rows hides live write bugs (the analysis pipeline in processing.py still writes double-encoded jsonb; it only looks clean because the backend restarted). The migration should be a one-off backfill, and writes should be correct.
The `||` jsonb concat corruption is invisible to jsonb_typeof-based checks — prefer element-level validation in the migration/tests.
review.py (2257 lines) and admin.py (2263 lines) both far exceed the 700-line guideline; split by resource (evidence, risks, workflow, transcript, export).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python3 tests/clear_rate_limit.py && python3 -m pytest tests/test_jsonb_fix_iter74.py -q -n 0 -p no:randomly (takes ~2.5 min; a full run needs >120s so background it). test_remaining_jsonb_iter74.py is a NEGATIVE suite — its 3 failures are the open bugs; it should go green once the developer removes the remaining json.dumps() calls. Also note: writing files under /app/backend triggers uvicorn hot reload → transient 502s from the public URL for a few seconds; retry rather than treating as a bug. Legacy suites test_team_insights_registers.py / test_report_lock.py are stale (Bearer-token auth) and fail with 401 regardless of product state.
rca_of_the_issue: asyncpg's jsonb type codec (database._init_connection: encoder=json.dumps) is registered on every pooled connection, so any call site that passes json.dumps(obj) to a `$N::jsonb` parameter is encoded twice and the column stores a JSON string of JSON (jsonb_typeof='string'). The developer removed json.dumps() from ~15 review.py/admin.py sites — verified fixed for all of them (learning_needs, actions, risks, cqc/care_cert mappings, achievements, attendees, sign_off_record, shared_with, speaker_colors all now jsonb_typeof array/object after live API writes, and persist across a fresh GET). But the same pattern remains in processing.py (the AI analysis INSERT), recording.py, org.py, admin.py (4 sites) and utils/seed.py; I proved two of them corrupt data live through the public API and found 113 already-corrupted rows in columns the startup repair migration does not cover.
